notes: 1.0.3: less 710-1. The image exports PAGER=less and cixctl pages through less, and no less package existed until now: every paged cixctl command in agent-1 said less: command not found (2026-10-31). 1.0.2: sed, which the Claude Code installer needs to read its manifest; without it the installer reported Platform linux-x64 not found in manifest (agent-1, 2026-10-31). sed is a shell tool an agent uses anyway, so it is declared rather than left to a dependency. 1.0.1: curl 8.21.0-7, whose CA bundle is explicit (cix#589). 8.21.0-6 had no compiled-in bundle, so curl in this image fell back to OpenSSL's /usr/lib/ssl, which holds no certificates, and failed every HTTPS fetch with unable to get local issuer certificate -- the Claude Code installer among them (measured in agent-1, 2026-10-31). 1.0.0: the agent workstation (cix#378, ADR-0366). jump's access stack (nslcd, PAM, sshd) and shell toolkit, plus cixctl, the cix recipe's own output (ADR-0367), rolling with each cix release. No compiler and no build system, so every build goes through the API. No node: Claude Code installs as a native binary into the operator's home on the agent-home volume (ADR-0366 amendment).
